label: High Distress and Loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: More likely to be female, have graduate-level education or above, and report more than 5 hours.

label: Low Distress and Low Loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms.

label: Higher loneliness with comparatively lower depression and anxiety
summary: This profile is characterized by elevated loneliness alongside comparatively lower average depressive and anxiety symptom levels. It suggests respondents who feel more socially disconnected while not showing similarly high emotional distress on depression and anxiety measures.
demographic_anchor: More commonly represented by women with graduate-level education or higher and daily usage in the 1-3 hour range.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows comparatively lower depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows comparatively lower anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Presents a pattern of social disconnection without equally elevated depression or anxiety
tone: Socially disconnected but otherwise comparatively emotionally stable
